report_title: VOXSHIELD Phase 1C.1 — Unseen Attack-System Data Audit

attack_system_field.meaning: Identifier of the specific TTS/VC synthesis algorithm, team, or vocoder system that produced the spoof trial ('-' indicates bona-fide speech).

source_families.vcc2020: Voice Conversion Challenge 2020 systems (Task1 / Task2 teams)
source_families.vcc2018: Voice Conversion Challenge 2018 systems (HUB / SPO baseline & submitted models)

candidate_split_designs.description: Train on VCC2020 + VCC2018 (97 attack systems); evaluate on ASVspoof 2019 algorithms (A07 - A19: 13 attack systems).
candidate_split_designs.separation_rule: Train/Val: source in ['vcc2020', 'vcc2018']; Test: source == 'asvspoof'. Zero attack overlap guaranteed.
candidate_split_designs.sample_balance_note: Ample samples available (153k spoofs and 5.9k bona-fide in test source).

candidate_split_designs.description: Balanced 2,000-sample benchmark with 20 attack systems strictly held out for test (0 attack overlap, 0 speaker overlap).
candidate_split_designs.separation_rule: Split 110 attack systems: 70 train, 20 val, 20 test. Split 92 speakers: 60 train, 16 val, 16 test disjointly.
candidate_split_designs.sample_balance_note: Perfect 50/50 bona/spoof balance achievable in each split.

feasibility_assessment.reason: The local dataset contains all 611,829 FLAC files for ASVspoof 2021 DF on disk, containing 110 distinct attack systems and 22,617 bona-fide samples across 92 speakers. The 3 source families (asvspoof with 13 systems, vcc2020 with 59 systems, and vcc2018 with 38 systems) are 100% mutually disjoint. A strict unseen-generator split can be readily created with 0 attack overlap and 0 speaker overlap.

candidate_designs.separation_rule: Train/Val: source in ['vcc2020', 'vcc2018']; Test: source == 'asvspoof'. Zero attack overlap guaranteed.

generalization_distinction.unseen_speaker_generalization: Evaluating on unseen human speakers using the same TTS/VC generators already seen in training. (Already achieved in Phase 1B).
generalization_distinction.unseen_attack_system_generalization: Evaluating on synthetic speech generated by vocoders/algorithms strictly absent from training, but within the academic ASVspoof 2021 DF distribution (e.g., holding out systems A07-A19).
generalization_distinction.commercial_tts_generalization: Evaluating on modern out-of-domain commercial voice cloning engines (ElevenLabs, OpenAI Voice, CosyVoice, XTTS-v2).
generalization_distinction.critical_caveat: Even an unseen ASVspoof attack-system split does NOT prove robustness against commercial-grade diffusion or autoregressive zero-shot clone engines. It is an intermediate benchmark of architectural generalization across known academic vocoders.

recommended_experiment.training_data: 700 bona-fide, 700 spoof from VCC2020 & VCC2018 (97 attack systems)
recommended_experiment.validation_data: 150 bona-fide, 150 spoof from VCC2020 & VCC2018 (same 97 attack systems, disjoint speakers)
recommended_experiment.unseen_evaluation_data: 150 bona-fide, 150 spoof from ASVspoof (systems A07-A19: 13 completely unseen attack systems)
recommended_experiment.attack_system_separation_rule: Train/Val systems ∩ Test systems = ∅ (Strict 0% attack-system overlap)
recommended_experiment.speaker_separation_rule: Train speakers ∩ Val speakers ∩ Test speakers = ∅ (Strict 0% speaker overlap)
recommended_experiment.expected_limitations: Measures transfer from VCC algorithms to ASVspoof 2019 algorithms; does not include external commercial TTS APIs.
